capabilities: Search file names, paths, aliases, headings, tags and note contents from the home page
Define launcher buttons that create notes, run commands, open files, folders, searches or URLs
Quick-capture lines into today's daily note or a chosen file
Show recent files and core bookmarks with hover preview
Display a quote of the day from a chosen note
extras: States that nothing leaves the vault: no network requests, telemetry or analytics. Includes an Obsidian version compatibility table (needs 1.11+, full features from 1.13.0) and notes it was built by SoulBits with Claude Code and has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Existing home page plugins offer a fixed set of blocks, so adding a button meant waiting for the author or stacking another plugin.
problem: Obsidian's default new tab is blank, so there is no single start page combining search, personal shortcuts, quick capture and recent files.

relations.evidence: Home Launcher connects to its public API and shows its results in the same search box

summary: New-tab home page with vault-wide search, custom launcher buttons, quick capture, a quote of the day, and recent files and bookmarks.
